CHAPTER.VERS: Sing a new song to Jehovah for he has done miraculous things. His right hand and his holy arm have gained victory for him.
Jehovah has made his salvation known. He has uncovered his righteousness for the nations to see.
He remembered his loving kindness and faithfulness to Israel's descendants. All the ends of the earth have seen how our God saves them.
Shout joyfully to Jehovah all the earth. Break out into joyful singing, and make music.
Make music to Jehovah with a lyre and with the melody of a psalm.
Make music with trumpets and the playing of a ram's horn. Shout happily in the presence of the king, Jehovah.
Let the sea and everything in it, the world and those who live in it roar like thunder.
Let the rivers clap their hands and the mountains sing joyfully.
This is in Jehovahs presence because he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and its people with fairness.
